she was very helpful and the topic was interesting.

Had her Freshman year and have not had a more interesting professor here to this day. She lectures in a way that is not only engaging, but very emotionally enticing. I highly recommend taking her class. I didn\'t have to put forth much effort to earn an A in her class. She\'s very interesting and frames her lectures in an intriguing way. Anyone claiming to have to put forth way too much effort in her class and only make a C does not belong at a university, much less as a history major.

If u hate easy A\'s and sweet helpful teachers, take this class. This is by far the hardest class i\'ve taken at LSU. She tells you not to be vague in answering her essay questions and her ?\'s are about as vague and broad as you can get. Spent ALL my time working in this class and finished w the lowest C possible. Don\'t waste your time and effort

Her class was very challenging and sometimes seemed to cause me more stress than a history class should. Her papers will STRESS YOU OUT. She says don\'t be vague but her prompts are always vague and broad. Kind of liberal, but seemed like a decent person. Luckily, I like history, but if you don\'t and just want an easy A, she isn\'t for you
Not an easy A, you\'ll have to write at least 5 small papers. Still, she\'s an awesome lecturer. :)

While attendance is not mandatory, she doesn\'t like it when you don\'t attend class (I always found the class too interesting to where I never wanted to skip).

Her class was tough but very interesting. I worked very hard in her class, and managed to get an A. She\'s also really helpful outside of class and is flexible on grades. If you like modern American history and don\'t mind working for your grade, this is the class for you.

This professor talked fast, didn\'t clarify what she was saying, and was very opinionated in the way she presented her information. she almost cried while lecturing one time, and i found her to be boring.

TALKS ENTIRELY TOO FAST. I had to start bringing my lap top to class just to keep up with her. She is out of touch with her students, and this is evident in her teaching methods. Sad to say I dont care for History as much anymore, and it is my major.
She wowwwwwwwwwsssss her students

For advanced work without a doubt one of the best. There is an inability to convey basic points in chemistry much to the expense of the class.

She smiles all the time even if there\'s nothing to smile about which is so annoying. She tells you that you failed her class with a big smile. She quizzes you in all discussions while she should "discuss" the material. Her quizzes are hard as hell and her tests are even harder. Homework is due every week & she\'s a hard grader.

What can I say about Yang.. Her exams are challenging, her quizzes are harder than her exams and there is homework due every week. She does NOT teach ANY concepts but the test is 50/50 on concepts and problem solving. She made her final exams out of pure AP Chemistry (collegeboard) exam questions... I would recommend but much studying is required.

She is very enthusiastic about teaching chemistry, but sometimes sidetracks the whole class explaining. Although she speaks English there is a bit of a language barrier. The course was slow at first but picked up towards the end. All in all she was an average professor.

Elaborately explains everything. Does all work n board to explain concepts. very kind and takes time to answer all questions to make sure you understand. Custom txbk fully used and reviewed in class. fair exams just make sure to read everything in the book and review bk/in-class calculations. attd not req but it\'d b wise Def. would recommend.

She will teach you what you need to know and does everything by hand on the board. She will answer all your questions. however she is one of the most difficult and unfair graders i have ever had. if you end up having her class study a lot and check all your problems before turning them in.
Don\'t ask her questions that are answered somewhere in the book! She has a great deal of energy and she is not afraid to use it. Don\'t ask her questions that are lame! She remembers EVERYTHING!
she won\'t give you an A if you don\'t deserve one. tough grader, yet nice person.

I\'m sure Dr. Yang is well meaning and a very nice individual, she might be the worst professor I\'ve had. Her lectures, if she even gives one, are unclear and unfocused. If I didn\'t want to have a lecture, I would have taken an online class. I was excited to take biochem and this class has been very disappointing.

Biochem with her was the worst experience. Drew half of the structures wrong so lectures weren\'t reliable. Asks more questions about gen bio/gen chem and ochem than biochem , so if you don\'t remember them , you are screwed. Lies about materials that won\'t be on the test but appear on the tests. Some of her wordrings for answers are very ambiguous

Stop crying. Everything on the test is from her notes. The book is helpful to read just to clarify things. She\'s always available during office hours. The extra chapters she gave weren\'t even covered in detail, it was very general so stop whining. She only did that to give you a basic idea of the whole subject. NO MATH PROBLEMS ON EXAMS! Awesome!

Hard to understand her. She will not aswer questions and her tests were different from the lectures and textbook. She will explain balancing equations and go over it but she will only explain the basic and easy problems ahe will not explain the breakage of a compound I was able to pass her class "c" by going to tutoring and another chem 100 class

I was reluctant to take her because of what everyone said but I can safely assume now that all of the students who complained about her have to be lazy or dim. I\'m still taking the course but so far the tests have been easy and her lectures helpful. You can\'t just rely on lectures to pass a test and students are obviously doing just that.

Go to her lectures, do the study questions, and study a few days before the exam - there is no reason why you shouldn\'t get an A. If you don\'t have a good background in chemistry/biology don\'t take this class. I got an A on every exam - highly recommend her.

HORRIBLE Prof. Lectures were completely useless and had nothing to do with test questions. She refuses to answer questions in class. You must teach yourself the material and she adds 5 CH. not required . She is the worst prof ever taken. I will NEVER take a class with her again.

HORRIBLE WORST BAD prof. never take here. never ever take her. she is far from humanity. she is a lier too. she would say read notes and exam will be from there but she will give you other stuff. she is the worst I ever seen in my life. DO NOT TAKE HER if you need high GPA for medical school

READ.THE.TEXTBOOK. I can\'t emphasize that enough. If you do not enjoy going to classes just read the full textbook and feel your life drag out of your body with the anything but fascinating text you are TRYING TO MEMORIZE. I really just didn\'t enjoy this course or his method of teaching at all.

He is a nice guy and seemed more than willing to help out. He\'s one of the worst professor i\'ve ever had, A lot of improvement is needed!!

Easily the coolest teacher I have run into this year. Funny guy and very interesting. He teaches of slides so learn how to write fast. You have to read the text to do well in his class. For someone barely scraping by with 60% on his tests I managed a B- without looking at the textbook. He cares about his students and responds to emails fast.
Lectures felt like you were watching a stand up comedian, not a professor lecturing. Exams were much harder than expected. Study EVERYTHING. Would not recommend.
awesome prof, awesome class. lectures were interesting and he\'s hilarious but not a lot of exam material was covered - just memorize the textbook, it\'s an easy A+.
YOU MUST READ THE TEXT BOOK! Some of the questions come straight out of that baby!

Read the textbook. Give yourself at least 2 nights to do this before midterms and at least 3 before the final. He gives practice questions which end up on the test. Chris likes to illustrate concepts using stories from his own life, which is interesting to a certain point. Go to class. Unhelpful slides but useful lecture material.

Not a great class. There were interesting parts to the lectures, but very little of it was tested. The textbook was the most important and helpful tool in the class. He talks about himself a lot, and spends a lot of time telling stories which waste time. He also showed up late almost everyday.
He\'s an awesome prof/person. The exams were fairly hard and required a lot of studying, but as long as you put in the effort you\'re fine. Take his classes if you can!

I loved this class, it was so interesting. However, you DO have to read the textbook and you DO have to memorize a lot. Some of my friends didn\'t go to class, but I think it really helps. Just make sure to read every page of the textbook he assigns or else you will NOT do good b/c the class is not curved. Easy A if you put in the effort
nice guy but tests can be really hard. literally memorize the textbook. every single thing in it even the stuff that doesnt seem important

Chris is a great person and a very likable lecturer. Unfortunately his tests are much more difficult than anything he talks about in class; which makes the ease of his lectures misleading. If you don\'t mind relying solely on the textbook to get a good mark in this class (with a funny prof on the side) then this class is for you.

Nice guy, but his lectures are hard to follow and inconsistent with the textbook making studying for exams challenging. Spends too much time talking about himself and telling stories, not enough time going over material. Too much of exam material was not covered in class. Ran out of time to finish the course material. Memorize the textbook to pass.

Definitely my favourite prof. Got involved with his students and put a lot of effort into his lectures. Wanted you to get more than just course material. Seemed passionate, was humorous, made it personal and relateable. Made lectures based on the experiences of our classmates with things like depression, which they sent him via email. Very cool.
Very nice guy, always keeps you interested throughout lectures. Lots of textbook on the tests but he usually gives you some hints before the tests overall a very good prof

Really nice prof overall. Likes to talk about his personal life a lot, but it\'s always very interesting. His tests are straight forward, but you do have to read the textbook because he doesn\'t cover everything in class. If there\'s going to be something on the exam from his lectures he lets you know, which is awesome!

An enthusiastic prof that is likeable and interesting. However, his exams are extremely tough which he thinks is cause we\'re "first years". Plus class is not curved so youre stuck with these lower marks. Also, tests on stuff in the textbook that he doesnt cover in class. Must attend class cause he tests on what he says as well.

Ok class. Lectures can be interesting. Likes to talk about himself. Very abstract thinking (hard to study for exams). Takes some tedious details from text book but also brings in his abstract train of thought from lectures. Going to class and reading text is must.

Interesting professor that has relatively easy tests. Attending class is a must since he tests on lecture content (~10-15%) not found in the textbook. Memorize the textbook and you\'ll be fine. Paper was a killer though. BEWARE!!! :o

She is a really easy prof to take. She makes her power point entertaining and is always happy. The notebook are easy to do and she gives u the right answer afterwards. Her test are basically off the notebook and her study guide is helpful. A really nice person as well. Also HOT
Easiest class I have ever taken. Just show up. she goes over the chapter before you do the lab in your group in class. She gives you a study guide for the quizzes which are multiple choice. Easy A.
Simple daily assignments out of the workbook and 3 short quizzes. Hot professor.

Wow! HOT! If her boyfriend didn\'t make Leonidas look like a midget, I\'d totally have asked her out after the semester was over! Oh well.. She is really helpful, super enthusiastic and really knows her stuff! Someone said her bf won all the departments scholarships or something, so I guess I better start studying and join the campus gym then retake!

WOW!She is by far the most gorgous teacher I have encounterd. She is willing to help any student in need. The subject was very intersting and all you have to do is show up and do the labs and you will pass. There are three exams(quizes)and they consisted of twenty questions each. The study guide she provides gives you all the info on the exams.EASY

Geography isn?t my subject but I really enjoyed the way Professor Stern explained things. She really tried to make everything relevant to us. I don?t think I?ll ever use map projections again but at least I know how to.
Ms. Stern was understanding and extremely helpful. She took the time to help me as much as I needed.
She is really cool and makes me want to do well.
She is cool, but she keeps us to the minute and once she starts talking, she goes on tangents for days. Otherwise, shes alright.
Interesting labs; knows what she is talking about.
Not clear, doesn\'t read labs/homework before giving it to us, so therefore cannot answer our questions.

While other professors talk theory and ideas, this professor shows us what she actually does in her classroom. She pushes her students to work hard, but is proud and excited when students meet their potential. She is one of the best professors I\'ve ever had!

I really liked this teacher. She was nice, fun and energetic. She understands what it is like to be a student. She is great and teachers the class with a real understanding of students needs as well as ideal experience of the teaching world.
No Comments

Prof. Matthews is a great english teacher. She will give you good advice when it comes to writting an essay. If you talk about world news, she may tell you a lot of things. Her class is not boring! She is great! I really miss her class. I really recommend you to have her for english! Fun class!
Jen is the best teacher I have had in College. Her classes are informative but fun, and she is helpful and fun outside of the classroom.
Top notch Professor.
Liked the class.
Good class.
Prof. Jen is cool, she\'s very approachable and engaging in class. Her teaching style makes me WANT to go to class. By far the hippest faculty member of the department.
I like this teacher a lot. She makes her classes interesting and willl go out of her way to help you if you hav a problem.

I love this professor. Her classes are always interesting, and she\'s very accessible. It seems that the students that don\'t like her class are the know-it-alls that want to teach the class themselves. Get over yourselves.
No Comments

Great Teacher. She is sort of a neo-hippie ;). I love her whole attitude. The kind of teacher you are pals with but still demands that you learn the material. uses great media to illustrate points.
He is very opinionative about certain things. If you opppose his beliefs, your papers will not result in good grades leaving you with a poor grade in the class. Do not take him.

The material of this course is extremely boring no matter what professor (So I\'ve been told).. but this guy is beyond boring, unorganized, gives no instructions for papers,and lectures for the entire class time.. don\'t take him, do yourselves a favor.
He is ridiculously biased for his own agenda and opinions to the contrary are just wrong in his eyes. His course content did not meet his own expectations. Cool, funny guy but not a good professor.
All over the place with context. Rarely gives out homework and the midterm and final are take home essays. Very boring class but he means well. Do not take at 8 am.

Hes really cute and pretty funny in a very odd way so its hard to hate him but the amount of work you get and the level of difficulty is just ridiculous for a 100 level class. Hes almost too smart for his own good. He goes off on tangents because his mind is just all over the place and therefor, so is the class. He is also a really harsh grader.

actually not a bad teacher, may come off as condensing at first but actually a pretty lenient guy with due dates and material on essays. no in class tests just take home essays. likes to joke around. not a real history class, he just covers topics he likes. good if you dont like history

ohhhh my god he is soooo hot. he strips his windbreaker in class and reveals his banana rpublic sweater vest and bowtie. has odd obsession with women studies.... probably because hes never seen a woman naked. he likes to talk about his \'girlfriend\' and growing mustaches. he is a pushover and easily manipulated, however he does not teach material.
He just talks about himself.

Much too much reading for a one-hundred level course. He enjoys the sound of his own voice, talking about his own research and more boring topics like women in the 1800?s, bad novels, whaling?Yuck! Yet he?s nice, sometimes funny, a little cute, helpful outside of class, and kind of an easy grader. Also, attendance is not mandatory :)
Boring, digresses, cant understand what hes talking about half the time. bad text book. however attendance isnt mandatory and hes not strict about the readings. MUST PARTICIPATE to get decent grade!
Vanessa is a great teacher. I love her and wish she wasn\'t gone! Very intimidating at first but worth the effort getting used to her. She\'s gone now due to having a baby.

Shes an awesome instructor.. a bit intimidating but its only because she wants you to really know what you are giving a patient and why. Shes very caring and helpful.. So sad she wont be back to teach anymore

Vanessa is really nice but a little intimidating at first until you get to know her. Gives a lot of feedback for care plans/ concept map. Leaves you alone during clinical but expects you to be very thorough when answering med questions while giving meds. Passed everyone in my clinical (thats saying a lot). Very good, highly recommend.
she has the tendency to choose favorites. she thinks she\'s superior at times and is intimidating, but she\'s not at all! sometimes shes not respectful

Had her for NURS1A and NURS1B. She is awesome! The epitome of a compassionate nurse and educator. She may have high standards but she will support you so you can meet those standards. If you want to learn, definitely take her!
This teacher has both good bedside and theory knowledge. Smart, helpful, and hot!
Excellent!!
She\'s a great professor, when you\'re done with her course you really know your stuff. Her course is the main reason I switched my major to Zoology!

I had her for sumer term Anatomy and Physiology and this was the first session I actually worried about whether I was going to pass. She doesn\'t emphasize anything, she\'s boring and her tests are ridiculous. The average grade on our second midterm was a D- and she still refused to curve. I wish Rocky were still here.

A tie between her and Rocky for the worst TAs in anatomy history @ OSU. She seems like a nice person, but her grading style is off the charts. Her meticulous and most anal ways are very annoying. She grades on small details that are absurd and minor (e.g., subtracting 10 pts because you were had one word too many on an essay). Pfft. What a shame.

I had her for Z 441 and liked her so much that I asked what day she was teaching before choosing Z 442. She is very clear about what she will test on, very patient, and is easy to talk to! She does grade on small details, but if you study, you should have no problem! Spelling counts on her midterms but not her quizzes. She wants you to learn!

I thought she was a good TA. She was very helpful and willing to explain and re-explain concepts. She may be tough, but the class is tough. I got a B+ and probably didn\'t put in as much effort as I should\'ve. She does grade small details, but she explicitly tells you that she is going to grade those certain details. She\'s not an unreasonable grader

super strict professor. extremely bright and intelligent, but marks off points the tiniest minute details like grammar and word usage. she is without a doubt, one of the hardest (if not already) anatomy TAs ever. her grading seems very easy, but she starts to dig into what you got wrong so fast. I\'d definitely choose another one if possible.

Worst science/zoology TA ever. She may be an extremely smart person, but her grading is off the wall. She is anal retentive about the smallest details. If she wants to become a phd, she should learn to ease up a bit. she\'ll deduct you for the most ridiculous reasons. i guess she\'s just very anal about some things. bleh.

She is a wonderful person. Very caring for the students and respected. But she grades on an impossible scale. Her strictness is incredible overeagering. Crucial points are deducted for extremely silly things (like verb usage--this is NOT an english class). She is noted for her "hard difficulty" compared to the rest of the TAs. I\'d pick a diff one.

An EXTREMELY difficult TA for the anatomy lab series. She is very smart and intelligent, yes. But she is also one of the most demanding and strictest "future" professors I have ever met. She is so thorough and detailed that she wants you to know every single object and expects you to be perfect in all your assignments. I would avoid if possible.

Dean Dr. Cone classes really helped you step up as a leader and to present your best. This professor chooses his words wisely and always has important things to say. Great teaching style! Syllabi was clear and grades Fairly. Very inspiring. Very knowledgable!

DO NOT take her unless you\'ve taken calculus before. She goes way too fast with her explanations. I got an A only because I\'d taken calc in high school. But just stay away

She has been the worst professor I\'ve experienced at UNT. Unwilling to help students, aggravated by those who have questions, and disrespectful to many students. Very good professor. Make sure you do the test review because it is basically the test. She just changed number. Don\'t know why so many dislike her. I did excellent in her class. Always make sure you know how to do every problem on her review.

Terrible teacher! Said "staff" so I didn\'t know I was taking her. She CANNOT teach! Hates to be proven wrong. Double check your test, she marked a question wrong on my test & I told her. She admitted she made a mistake but would not give me credit! Passed class with a C, final exam is what saved me. Counts 40%. Show lots of work on free response!!!

Awful teacher, clears her throat all the time, gets sassy when proven wrong. Does example after example with no explanation or reasoning. Tests are free response so if you mess up wrong screwed. Mymathlab teaches the class better than she does, started going to class and taking notes and they did not help at all. Wolframalpha and Mathlab helped me.

I learned nothing from her teaching. Everything i learned was from the homework or spending literally hours in the help center doing her test reviews. Her test are 13 questions and she grades the free response harshly. If you are willing to put the effort and time to learn on your own take her. She teaches talks to the board the whole class

Worst math teacher I\'ve had in a LONG time. She never actually teaches anything. She lectures to the chalkboard doing example after example never explaining why she\'s doing something a certain way. Tests are always less than 15 questions so there is never any room for mistakes. Don\'t take her if possible!
Horrible Teacher. Cannot understand anything taught. Help yourself and do not take her.

This was a 5wk summer class so it was a lot of material to cover and we went really fast, but she was very organized and presented the material clearly. She has great handwriting, which I think is pretty important for teaching math. She isn\'t the best at fielding questions during the lecture, but if you visit her office she is extremely helpful.

She clears her throat a lot and looks at the ground while she lectures. Her hw assignments were so big that there were times when no one in the class had been able to complete it, and the examples she gave in class did not relate to the hw or the test problems. Her tests were easy because she gave reviews, but I would not recommend this professor.

Larsen does give out quite the work load when it comes to homework, and many of the problems are not easy at all. Also, I think the examples she gives in class are sometimes irrelevant to what the problems cover. However, her tests are so easy, and she loves having students ask her homework questions during her office hours. She is a great teacher!

A lot of homework, and that is by no means an understatement. Expect to spend at least ten to twenty minutes per problem near the end of the semester. On the plus side, the tests are fairly simple, but your homework grade will suffer.
She\'s not as bad as other reviewers are making her out to be, although I agree that she clears her throat way too much. It\'s distracting.

Judging from past reviews, she has improved greatly in her teaching methods. She still gives out hw every day, but she communicates regularly with the class, does not require attendance, and is fairly lenient with students skipping "obvious" steps. Calculus is just a hard topic.
